[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

## Customer Reviews

“

Barb and Joe have been great. I appreciate Joe answering all my questions. We are in a unique
situation and he was very helpful.
– Elizabeth S.

Instructor is very knowledgeable and I have learned a lot more than what I know now. This will
definitely help me to narrow a problem down and fix it.
– Voluson Training Course Attendee

Website was very helpful and comprehensive. Staff help was quick and informative. Special thanks to
Tim Maltby and his in-depth knowledge and help with the purchase.

This was a great course and I learned a lot about the Epiq ultrasound that I will carry to my sites.

Very practical and hands-on course. Focused on real problems and learning the most important parts
of the system and how to fix them.

This purchase was made possible by a grant that our company applied for. Joe Hicks patiently waited
the six months it took to hear if our grant application was accepted. Today I received the
transducers we purchased and I couldn’t be happier! I will finally be able to perform thyroid
ultrasounds, and will possibly be looking into musculoskeletal scans.

Mark Asmer made my buying experience very smooth. I was afraid of buying from an online company I
found from a Google search. After dealing with a few different online vendors, Mark’s knowledge of
the products definitely stood out compared to the others. He answered all my questions and was very
responsive. I would highly recommend Probo Medical.

“Very prompt, efficient, knowledgeable, through, and professional. After 3 years of poor service
from GE, I am happy to know we have an excellent service engineer to take care of this Voluson E6
system we have. I believe we are in good hands.”

Hobie’s knowledge of the product was great. His class management with time and hands-on
[training][100] kept the class engaged. Thank you!

–Chad, Basic US & Epiq/Affiniti

The courses are impactful and the instructor keeps us interested. This will be my second course and
we will send others in our company to take these courses.

Glenn was a pleasure to work with. He was very patient with me. It was a process to get the business
loan and took much longer to get the funds. Then I wasn’t able to have the machine delivered until
after Christmas and he was very accommodating.

I reached out to generic support via the website, and received a response from Joe Hicks within the
hour. I had an Epiq 7 ultrasound that was down, which caused mass postponements of patient
appointments. And this being one of our smaller clinics, the sonographer for this particular machine
was unable to work. Joe worked with me every step of the way, providing multiple quotes, all the way
up until he was able to ensure me of a Field Service Engineer being on site with needed component in
hand, all within 24 business hours of receiving PO. Not to mention that the component was readily
available on hand, at less than half what OEM quoted. Although this is my first transaction with
Probo Medical, it absolutely will not be my last!

Hobie is a fantastic instructor, he has an abundance of knowledge and shares it very well. The
reason I came to take this course was to gain knowledge and be educated by Hobie. I am a veteran in
this field, and every time Hobie teaches me something new.
– Ricky D.

It is always easy to work with Probo Medical and Terry. In recent years, Terry has been helping us
with multiple ultrasound equipment rentals, including ultrasound systems and ultrasound probes.
Terry always gave quick responses in system quotes and related information inquiries. Plus, she is
very professional in handling technical questions, which is a big help for customers to better use
rental equipment for their projects.

– Fuxing Y., Ph.D. Principal Application Engineer

Mark Asmer was amazing! He promptly answered every question, made sure we came in at our budget, and
got us the best machine for the best price.

The course was very insightful and full of a lot of great information. I feel more confident in
servicing ultrasound equipment, and our instructor was excellent and very knowledgeable.
– Jonathan L.

I loved working with Joe. He was always very prompt with communication, had answers for all of my
questions and was knowledgeable with the products. He was supportive in my business endeavors and
friendly and I really Appreciate all the help and patience through this process.

I had initially called to ask some questions about machines as I was having a difficult time
deciding between a newer [GE Voluson S8][101] or S10 like I already owned or upgrading to the
Voluson E line. Glenn Josephik was very helpful and knowledgeable about the different Volusons and
was able to answer my questions fully allowing me the information needed to make my definite
decision.

I had an excellent experience purchasing my ultrasound machine with Probo medical. Glenn was
incredibly knowledgeable and provided clear, detailed answers to all of my questions. He was timely
in responses and always pleasant and patient, ensuring that I felt confident in my decision. I truly
appreciated his professionalism and dedication to helping me find the perfect machine for my needs.
The entire process was smooth and stress-free, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with my purchase.

Russell has gone above and beyond what anyone has ever done for our dexa/bone density problems. He
is with his weight in gold. He has come up with ideas and solutions with a depth of knowledge and
understanding of both the medical and technical fields associated with the dexa scan.

Enrico Franchini, so good at working across time zones and with different communication styles to
achieve what we needed.

Our representative was Tim Maltby. I contacted Tim back in February to request a quote for an
[ultrasound probe][102]. He got back to me right away. When I reached out to him this month to
inquire if the probe was still in stock as we were ready to purchase, he was so generous in giving
us the original price quoted and worked with our administrative assistant to get the purchase done.
Fast and thoughtful service. Once the order had been placed, the probe arrived 2-3 days later which
was amazing.

This was our first experience with Probo and from the first phone call to final delivery and
payment, Joe Hicks was straightforward and open to helping the entire way.

This helped me feel more confident in being able to service the unit when needed.
– Rana H. Epiq Training Course

Great and informative course. Introduction to ultrasound is a major plus for someone with limited or
zero knowledge.
Tyler Y.

Glenn made this experience as painless as possible. The

  Butterfly iQ+ and iQ3 are FDA-cleared handheld ultrasound devices that connect to a compatible

  technology, which replaces the multiple piezoelectric probes required by traditional ultrasound
  systems with a single handheld probe capable of whole-body imaging. iQ3 offers improved image
  quality and extended battery life compared to iQ+.
  
  ### What is handheld ultrasound?
  
  Handheld ultrasound is a portable imaging solution that allows clinicians to perform ultrasound
  exams at the point of care — at the bedside, in the clinic, or in the field — using a compact,
  pocket-sized device. Unlike traditional cart-based ultrasound systems, handheld devices like the
  Butterfly iQ3 connect directly to a compatible smartphone or tablet, eliminating the need for
  dedicated hardware and enabling faster, more flexible clinical workflows.
  
  ### Why is Butterfly different from traditional ultrasound systems?
  
  Butterfly replaces traditional ultrasound — both cart-based systems and handheld piezoelectric
  devices — with a single semiconductor-based probe built on Ultrasound-on-Chip™ technology.
  Traditional systems require multiple probes, costly hardware maintenance, and dedicated carts.
  Butterfly's single probe performs multiple imaging modes across the whole body with software that
  improves over time, and is priced much lower than what conventional system costs.
  
  ### Does Butterfly use AI in ultrasound?
  
  Yes. Butterfly integrates AI across image capture, clinical workflows, and enterprise management.
  On-device AI tools assist with image guidance, anatomy identification, and real-time feedback.
  Butterfly's CompassAI™ enterprise software automates documentation, quality assurance, and billing
  workflows for point-of-care ultrasound programs.

  Butterfly ultrasound is used by a wide range of healthcare professionals including emergency
  physicians, hospitalists, intensivists, cardiologists, anesthesiologists, primary care providers,
  nurses, paramedics, military medics, and medical students. Butterfly devices are deployed in
  emergency departments, ICUs, operating rooms, outpatient clinics, primary care practices, and
  remote or resource-limited settings.
  
  ### Is AI-assisted ultrasound accurate?
  
  AI-assisted ultrasound tools, including those in Butterfly devices, are designed to improve
  consistency in image acquisition and support clinical workflows — not to replace clinical
  judgment. Butterfly's AI guidance helps clinicians acquire better images faster, which can improve
  the reliability of findings. As with all diagnostic tools, trained clinical interpretation remains
  essential.

  membership tier, and whether the purchase is for individual or enterprise use. Enterprise pricing
  includes additional workflow tools, analytics, and volume options. A Butterfly membership
  subscription is required and unlocks cloud storage, AI-powered features, and ongoing software
  updates.

  Yes. A Butterfly membership is required and is designed to expand the device's capabilities over
  time. Membership tiers provide access to cloud storage, workflow tools, and AI-powered features.
  Because Butterfly is a software-driven platform, new capabilities are delivered through software
  updates to the same hardware — meaning the device improves with the membership.

  simulation-based training application — along with on-demand learning modules and live training

  via CompassAI, and dedicated customer success resources. All active memberships include software
  updates and customer support.

  clinical decision-making, and reduced reliance on external imaging referrals. A key driver for
  enterprise customers is Butterfly's CompassAI workflow software, which captures documentation in
  real time and reduces unrecorded or 'ghost' scans. By improving billing compliance and capturing
  revenue from scans that would otherwise go undocumented, CompassAI can help health systems realize
  measurable financial returns.

  the navigation bar and complete the request form.

confidence.

Factory

In-house production and inspection workflow covering material preparation, machining, testing, and
batch control.

[Production Environment]

Our PZT ceramic components are widely used in ultrasonic cleaning, medical ultrasound, flow meters,
level measurement, piezoelectric actuators and HIFU applications.

Cleaning

PZT rings and discs for high-power cleaning transducers and industrial cleaning tank assemblies.

Medical

Custom piezoelectric elements for diagnostic probes, therapeutic ultrasound, and acoustic medical
devices.

### Ultrasonic Flow Meter

Piezoelectric ceramic parts for ultrasonic water meters, heat meters, and flow measurement modules.

PZT transducer components for non-contact liquid level and distance sensing applications.

### Piezoelectric Actuators

Multilayer and custom piezo elements for compact displacement, vibration, and actuation designs.

# Factory-Direct Manufacturer of Custom PZT Ceramic Components for Ultrasonic Devices

Precision-engineered piezoelectric ceramic parts for medical, industrial, and custom ultrasonic
applications.

[Request a Quote][11] [View PZT Products][12]

## Our PZT Ceramic Products

PZT discs, rings, tubes, plates and custom piezoelectric ceramic components for OEM applications.

[ Disc

### Piezoelectric Ceramic Discs

Circular ceramic elements for ultrasonic transducers, sensors, and OEM assemblies.

View category ][13] [ Ring

### Piezoelectric Ceramic Rings

Ring structures for focused acoustic output and compact ultrasonic integration.

View category ][14] [ Plate

### Piezoelectric Ceramic Plates

Rectangular and custom plate geometries for precision transducer and device structures.

View category ][15] [ Tube

### Piezoelectric Ceramic Tubes

Thin-wall and thick-wall tube components for atomizers, sensing, and actuation designs.

View category ][16] [ Multilayer

### Multilayer Piezo Components

Stacked ceramic components for compact, high-output, and energy-efficient piezoelectric
applications.

View category ][17] [ Custom

### Special Shape Piezo Components

Custom-shaped piezoelectric parts designed for OEM requirements and specialized device integration.

View category ][18]

## Why Choose Us

Experience

### 14+ Years

Focused manufacturing experience in piezoelectric ceramics and ultrasonic applications.

Production

### 5,000 m2 Facility

Integrated production, inspection, and batch control for stable output.

Quality

### ISO 9001 Quality System

Documented process control from material input to final shipment.

Customization

### OEM / ODM Support

Custom dimensions, material grades, electrodes, and electrical specifications.

Engineering

### Application Engineering Support

Technical communication for material selection, geometry review, and prototype decisions.

Consistency

### Batch Consistency Control

Inspection standards for repeatable capacitance, frequency, and dimensional quality.

Matching

### Material Performance Matching

Material, dimensions, and electrical parameters matched to target device requirements.

Prototyping

### Prototype Support

Sample feedback and manufacturability guidance for pilot production.

Delivery

### Global Delivery Coordination

Responsive scheduling and project follow-up for international OEM cooperation.

## Certificates & Quality Assurance

Certified processes, documented controls, and in-house production support stable piezoelectric
ceramic manufacturing.

Certification

### ISO & Compliance

Documented quality management, certification records, and inspection standards for stable OEM
production.

[ISO & Compliance]
Honors

### Qualifications & Awards

Manufacturing credentials, industry recognition, and supporting documents for long-term supply
confidence.

[Qualifications & Awards]
Factory

### Production Environment

In-house production and inspection workflow covering material preparation, machining, testing, and
batch control.

[Production Environment]

## Applications of PZT Ceramics

Our PZT ceramic components are widely used in ultrasonic cleaning, medical ultrasound, flow meters,
level measurement, piezoelectric actuators and HIFU applications.

Cleaning

### Ultrasonic Cleaning

PZT rings and discs for high-power cleaning transducers and industrial cleaning tank assemblies.

Medical

### Medical Ultrasound

Custom piezoelectric elements for diagnostic probes, therapeutic ultrasound, and acoustic medical
devices.

Metering

### Ultrasonic Flow Meter

Piezoelectric ceramic parts for ultrasonic water meters, heat meters, and flow measurement modules.

Level

### Ultrasonic Level Measurement

PZT transducer components for non-contact liquid level and distance sensing applications.

Actuation

### Piezoelectric Actuators

Multilayer and custom piezo elements for compact displacement, vibration, and actuation designs.

HIFU

### HIFU Applications

Focused piezoelectric ceramic elements for high-intensity focused ultrasound assemblies.

## Case Studies

### Geisinger Improves Ultrasound Documentation Time and Billed Volume

In addition to streamlining the use of POCUS at their facilities, Geisinger has also seen an
accelerated rate of completed POCUS documentation.

[Read More][29]

### Assessment of an Artificial Intelligence Tool for Estimating LVEF in Echocardiograms

Published in the healthcare journal, Diagnotics, the authors of this article shared the following
abstract: This work aims to evaluate the performance of a new artificial intelligence tool (Exo AI)
to compute the left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) in echocardiograms of the apical and
parasternal long axis (PLAX) views. We retrospectively gathered echocardiograms from 441 individual
patients (70% male, age: 67.3 ± 15.3, weight: 87.7 ± 25.4, BMI: 29.5 ± 7.4) and computed the
ejection fraction in each echocardiogram using the ExoAI algorithm. We compared its performance
against the ejection fraction from the clinical report. ExoAI achieved a root mean squared error of
7.58% in A2C, 7.45% in A4C, and 7.29% in PLAX, and correlations of 0.79, 0.75, and 0.89,
respectively. As for the detection of low EF values (EF < 50%), ExoAI achieved an accuracy of 83% in
A2C, 80% in A4C, and 91% in PLAX. Our results suggest that ExoAI effectively estimates the LVEF and
it is an effective tool for estimating abnormal ejection fraction values (EF < 50%). Importantly,
the PLAX view allows for the estimation of the ejection fraction when it is not feasible to acquire
apical views (e.g., in ICU settings where it is not possible to move the patient to obtain an apical
scan).

Wellstar MCG Health implemented Exo Works®, Exo’s point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) workflow
solution, to accelerate patient care and streamline exam documentation, quality assurance (QA),
regulatory compliance, and revenue capture at the medical facility.

## Case Studies

1/3

### Geisinger Improves Ultrasound Documentation Time and Billed Volume

In addition to streamlining the use of POCUS at their facilities, Geisinger has also seen an
accelerated rate of completed POCUS documentation.

[Read More][29]

### Assessment of an Artificial Intelligence Tool for Estimating LVEF in Echocardiograms

Published in the healthcare journal, Diagnotics, the authors of this article shared the following
abstract: This work aims to evaluate the performance of a new artificial intelligence tool (Exo AI)
to compute the left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) in echocardiograms of the apical and
parasternal long axis (PLAX) views. We retrospectively gathered echocardiograms from 441 individual
patients (70% male, age: 67.3 ± 15.3, weight: 87.7 ± 25.4, BMI: 29.5 ± 7.4) and computed the
ejection fraction in each echocardiogram using the ExoAI algorithm. We compared its performance
against the ejection fraction from the clinical report. ExoAI achieved a root mean squared error of
7.58% in A2C, 7.45% in A4C, and 7.29% in PLAX, and correlations of 0.79, 0.75, and 0.89,
respectively. As for the detection of low EF values (EF < 50%), ExoAI achieved an accuracy of 83% in
A2C, 80% in A4C, and 91% in PLAX. Our results suggest that ExoAI effectively estimates the LVEF and
it is an effective tool for estimating abnormal ejection fraction values (EF < 50%). Importantly,
the PLAX view allows for the estimation of the ejection fraction when it is not feasible to acquire
apical views (e.g., in ICU settings where it is not possible to move the patient to obtain an apical
scan).

[Read More][30]

Wellstar MCG Health implemented Exo Works®, Exo’s point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) workflow
solution, to accelerate patient care and streamline exam documentation, quality assurance (QA),
regulatory compliance, and revenue capture at the medical facility.

## Our Portable Ultrasound Scanner Used Everywhere
* ## Sonic G1-Clinic's General Handheld Ultrasound Machine
  
  The Sonic G1 is an affordable, handheld ultrasound machine designed for doctors in communities,
  townships, and clinics. It provides clear, detailed views of a patient’s internal condition,
  enhancing your accuracy of initial diagnoses. Say goodbye to the expense and complexity of
  traditional ultrasound machines. Our phone ultrasound is lightweight, portable, and easy to use,
  featuring 21 built-in preset programs for common areas. From superficial to deep, achieving
  one-click screenings. With extremely low consumable costs per examination and easy maintenance, it
  makes every screening both economical and efficient. Effortlessly flip the device for whole-body
  examinations, all while offering pro-grade imaging at an entry-level price. HiSONO's Sonic G1 is
  the ideal, cost-effective solution for your primary healthcare. Order now and equip your practice
  with this game-changing wireless portable ultrasound scanner, empowering diagnoses and enhancing
  community healthcare.
* ## Sonic D1 Cardiovascular Portable Ultrasound Machines
  
  In personal health and family monitoring, achieving both professionalism and convenience is often
  difficult – until the advent of the Sonic D1 handheld ultrasound device. This scanner allows
  one-button switching between detailed superficial imaging and deep cardiac monitoring. For
  patients with chronic diseases, it provides continuous and convenient vital sign tracking, making
  daily health management easy and reliable. For family health managers, its minimalist operation
  and secure sharing platform allow family doctors to quickly understand a patient's condition,
  enabling remote consultations from home. For sports enthusiasts, it clearly displays surface
  structures and provides deep cardiac feedback, offering objective data on training effectiveness.
  And for medical students, our portable MSK ultrasound is an easily accessible mobile teaching
  tool. We have integrated long-lasting dual batteries and a user-friendly design, empowering
  everyone to use a home ultrasound scanner to detect and manage their health earlier and with
  greater peace of mind.
* ## Sonic C1 Cardiac Handheld Ultrasound Device
  
  Our Sonic C1 is a pro-grade portable cardiac ultrasound engineered for cardiologists, ICU
  physicians, and pre-hospital emergency personnel. Integrating HD imaging, CW Doppler mode, and
  cardiac-intelligent presets, the device enhances diagnostic accuracy and flexibility. The
  high-resolution dynamic imaging eliminates blurring and lag, ensuring clinicians can clearly
  identify subtle cardiac abnormalities, while cardiac-specific presets support one-click fast
  startup to streamline workflow. In addition, the mini ultrasound machine is fully DICOM
  compatible, ensuring seamless integration with hospital PACS systems. Easily achieve stable and
  reliable image and data transmission, storage, and sharing, thereby facilitating medical record
  archiving and ensuring efficient multidisciplinary consultations. HiSONO Sonic C1 Cardiac
  Ultrasound provides precise, efficient point-of-care cardiac diagnosis, empowering clinicians to
  deliver high-quality cardiac care anytime, anywhere. Buy the pocket ultrasound device now and
  experience reliable visual diagnostics with hospital-grade imaging technology!

hospitals. Our mission is to provide healthcare professionals with the best tools and technologies
to enhance patient care and improve clinical outcomes.

instrumentation, portable ultrasound devices, ventilators, and more from top brands in the
industry.We Also offer equipment from Major Brands with Categories from AED Defibrillators,
Autoclave Sterilizer, Ultrasound Equipment, EKG Machine, Medical Ventilators, and Any Medical
Equipment.

Choosing Marcroft Medical as your medical equipment supplier means partnering with a company
committed to your success. We understand the critical role that high-quality medical equipment plays
in patient care and are dedicated to supporting healthcare professionals with the best products and
services.

#### ABOUT US

**Our Mission**

**Mobile Mama Ultrasound was established to offer quality OBGYN ultrasound service outside of the
traditional medical setting.  We strive to provide a high standard of imaging and personalized
care.**



**Owner**

***Kiah McArdle, B.S., RDMS (OB/GYN, ABD), RDCS (FE), RT(R).  ***



** I am a Registered Sonographer who has been working exclusively in Obstetrics & Gynecology since
2010.  From IVF to routine OB care to Maternal Fetal Medicine, I have been blessed to be a part of
the care team of countless mothers-to-be.  I am passionate about Women's health and the role that
ultrasound serves in both pregnancy and non-pregnant care.  I understand that bonding with your baby
begins in the womb.  Pregnancy ultrasounds provide a unique opportunity for expectant moms, dads,
and families to connect with their unborn baby.  The ability to see baby's movements, facial
features, hair, cheeks, and toes generates an indescribable and instantaneous love.  I have
experienced the same joy with my own three children, and it gives me great happiness to provide both
Diagnostic and Elective home-based services to others!  **

## Advancing the Field,

## Serving the Community

The POCUS Certification Academy is committed to expanding the knowledge and practical application of
point-of-care ultrasound around the world. In partnership with a community of POCUS experts, we
offer certifications and educational opportunities that equip professionals to learn and deliver
unprecedented patient diagnosis, care, and safety while using point-of-care ultrasound.

Whether you are a physician, nurse practitioner, midwife, or anesthetist, the POCUS Certification
Academy has certification opportunities to support your unique practice setting

### 124

#### Countries

124 countries across the globe rely on and recognize POCUS Certifications.

### 150K+

#### Clinicians Certified

150,000+ clinicians have taken advantage of online assessments to get certified.

### 1.8M+

#### Patients Cared For

Certified clinicians care for 1,800,000+ patients each day.

## Start Your Certification Journey Today

[Education & Training Icon]

 

## [Education & Training][39]

Explore our Learning Library or dig deeper and sign up for a course or training program from one of
our POCUS Education Providers.

[POCUS Fundamentals Certificate Icon]

 

## [POCUS Fundamentals Certificate][40]

Combining learning modules and assessments along the way, the Fundamentals Certificate functions as
an introductory course in POCUS, with a focus on the basic physics and instrumentation of
ultrasound. It is a prerequisite for more advanced certifications.

[Clinical & Specialty Certificates Icon]

 

## [Clinical & Specialty Certifications][41]

After successfully completing your Fundamentals Certificate, validate your knowledge of advanced
POCUS use with our Clinical Certifications or bundle them together with one of our Specialty
Certifications.

## More to Explore

[Congratulating Doctor on POCUS certifications]
TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

#### New: POCUS HeartFocus Certification Program

Build competency with the HeartFocus app and achieve certification through our newest program.

[Learn More][42]
[Learning Resources]
WEBINAR

#### July 29th @ 12PM | POCUS for Primary Care Physicians

Attendees will walk away with practical POCUS skills across three core exam domains: cardiac,
abdominal & chest, extremities.

[Register Now][43]
RESEARCH

#### POCUS25 Domains

POCUS25 is a ranked list of the top 25 POCUS domains, as determined by survey data obtained through
the POCUS25 research study.

[View List][44]

## Volunteer Today!

### *Help us Elevate the Standards for Better Health Outcomes*

POCUS is dramatically expanding how people use ultrasound around the globe. If you are an
experienced POCUS clinician and would like to help us develop future exam questions, webinar content
and/or blog articles, we would love to hear from you.

[Explore Volunteer Opportunities][45]
